About us

Lakshmi Group is one of the leading names in Automobile Dealership across South India. Started in the year 1988 with Hero Motors Dealership and Later incorporated as Private Limited Company Under the Companies Act having its Registered Office at Hyderabad on 21st May 1998.

Mr. K. Rama Mohana Rao is the main Promoter of Lakshmi Group who established the Organisation in the Year 1988 with a moto of Customer Delight with high Quality Sales and Service Experience. Lakshmi Group as on date operates through 60+ state of art Workshops, 50 Showrooms, 8 Used Car Showrooms, 16 Commercial Showrooms and 1 Driving School, spread across Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka and Tamil Nadu.

Lakshmi Group ensures its customers a unique buying experience and matches that with an equal commitment to offer high quality customer satisfaction with best in class after sales experience. They have delivered 3,50,000+ new Vehicles and Serviced 30,00,000+ vehicles during these 34 years of Automobile Journey.

Lakshmi Group has a highly professional and motivated Team of 4,545 employees hired from different parts of India with a Group Turnover of 2,500 crores.
